Shared infrastructure

Group-wide requirements and project uses refer to the same potential installation where their owners confirm it. Compute, retained evidence storage, runners, metrology, workshop and support roles must be reconciled before an institute-wide quantity, area or budget is published.

The present inventory is a set of requirements, not a sum of purchases. Confirmed quantities and prices require their own evidence. Preliminary staffing, area and price-class estimates are marked with author/date; shared resources and overlapping scenarios are reconciled before any institute total.
